summary_1line: Hanuman devastates Ravana’s Ashoka grove to provoke battle, and Ravana sends eighty thousand Kinkara demons to capture him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman, grown विशाल like a hill, rips up trees in the Ashoka grove as animals flee and shattered pavilions collapse around him.
Standing at Lanka’s gate, Hanuman roars and lashes his immense tail while thousands of armed Kinkara demons rush toward him.
In his palace, Ravana’s eyes blaze with fury and tears fall like burning oil as he orders eighty thousand Kinkaras to seize the monkey.
